parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the main structural frame of the cabinet, made of wood, providing support and shape to the furniture.
parts.Functional_description: It supports all other parts including doors and shelves, maintaining the cabinet’s rigidity and stability.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that holds the entire structure together.

parts.name: Cabinet Door (Left)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left door of the cabinet, made of wood, used to cover and access the storage space.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the interior of the cabinet by opening and closing, protecting stored items from dust and view.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates or slides depending on the hinge or track mechanism.

parts.name: Cabinet Door (Right)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right door of the cabinet, made of wood, complementing the left door for full enclosure.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the right section of the cabinet and helps secure the contents inside.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates or slides depending on the hinge or track mechanism.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: This is an internal horizontal shelf made of wood, dividing the cabinet’s interior space.
parts.Functional_description: It supports stored items, increasing the cabinet’s storage capacity and organization.
parts.Movement_description: It is typically fixed or adjustable vertically but does not move during normal use.
